newsitem.title: USA: SGS-Thomson projects Q3 gross margin.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson projects Q3 gross margin.

text.p: SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV, the French semiconductor manufacturer, said its gross margin this quarter could be below the 40.1 percent of last year's third quarter, a group vice president said, repeating a projection SGS-Thomson made in July.

Francois Guibert, group vice president, business development and investor relations, told the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference that SGS-Thomson also expects revenues to be below second quarter revenues of $1.05 billion but above year ago third quarter revenues of $922.6 million. SGS-Thomson stated also that projection in July.
